settings.when: Saturday, June 12, 2027 · Willowbank Orchard, Germantown, NY
settings.lead: We're getting married under the apple trees, and we would love you to be there. This site has everything you need for the weekend: the schedule, where to stay, what to do, and the RSVP.

settings.text:
Ten years ago we met over a secondhand paperback. Since then there have been four apartments, one very loud beagle and more road trips than either of us can count.
We can't think of a better way to start the next chapter than in an orchard full of the people we love.

settings.headline: Three days in
settings.subtitle: Welcome drinks on Friday, the wedding on Saturday afternoon, and a slow brunch on Sunday before everyone heads home.

settings.subtitle: Ten years of trips and long walks, drawn as postcards.
